about: [manager] the propagation and variety test (the user's rules, O9_ALIVE.md 1b and 1c; OPEN_WORLD.md): one shot on the quay at night with nobody near raises no heat and draws nobody; the same shot at the GRAND - CENTRE stop draws the stop's people, two reports and a patrol car; a man two blocks away never flinches; of the dozen reacting no two do the same thing the same way. Run at every merge check; the counts reported. NOIR_PORT=5370 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/mgr/propagation.json

steps.eval: (G.save.flags.taught = { city_in: true, city_drive: true, city_map: true, city_gun: true, o3_punch: true }, 1)

steps.check: D.shotLogged && D.heatMax === 0 && D.reactors.near60 <= D.near45 + 2 && D.reactors.far120 === 0 && (!D.farMan || !D.farMan.flinched) && D.police.carMinD > 60 && (D.near45 > 0 || D.reports.max === 0)
steps.label: a shot on the quay with nobody near: no heat, nobody drawn but those who were there, nobody far away flinching, no patrol car

steps.check: D.shotLogged && D.reactors.near45 >= 3 && D.reports.max >= 2 && D.police.carMinD < 40 && D.reactors.far120 === 0 && (!D.farMan || !D.farMan.flinched) && D.variety.at3 && D.variety.at3.sameWay === 0
